description: Land Acquisition - Ambadeniya, Mawanella D/S Division, and Bakulwala, Aranayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District - Peddapitiya, Akuressa, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, boundaries, and ownership details. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
